_comment: DISABLED: Ender IO's SAG Mill must not grind a blaze rod back into powder (owner, 2026-08-21).
This file sits at Ender IO's OWN recipe id, replaces it, and never loads, so the recipe is absent.
Moved out of Recompile into the pack (trashlands#52), where curating another mod's recipes belongs.
WHY. Ender IO grinds one rod into FOUR powder. Recompile runs the other way - four powder press into
a Blaze Briquette and the Sintering Kiln fires it into one rod - so this recipe makes the round trip
break even, and with a grinding ball's output multiplier (up to 1.75 on the vibrant alloy ball) a rod
returns up to SEVEN powder: a 75 percent automatable gain. Blaze rods gate brewing here.
DISABLED RATHER THAN REBALANCED (owner ruling): no number to re-check when Ender IO retunes its balls.
HOW A DISABLE WORKS, since there is no remove-recipe primitive. A file at another mod's recipe id
replaces it wholesale, and a neoforge:never condition means the replacement never loads either. The
body is valid only so the file is well-formed; it is never decoded.
LOAD ORDER. An override only wins if it is read after the mod's own data. KubeJS data does: measured
2026-09-10 on a dedicated server, a pack file at enderio:blocks/alloy_smelter replaced Ender IO's own
table outright. Recompile still ships an identical copy until its next release; the two agree, and
check_pack_deps.py fails CI if they stop agreeing.
